newsitem.title: USA: Haggar Corp sees Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Haggar Corp sees Q3 loss.

text.p: Haggar Corp said Thursday it expects third quarter sales to fall below targeted levels, resulting in a net loss for the quarter of $1.6 million to $2.2 million or $0.19 to $0.26 per share.

The company said the lower sales are largely due to disappointing retail sales earlier in the quarter and during the Father's Day holiday buying season. Haggar anticipates net sales of $86 million to $90 million in the third quarter, which ends June 30.
Haggar earned a profit of $0.13 a share on about $103.8 million in sales in last year's third quarter.

J. M. Haggar III, chairman and chief executive said, "The sluggish Father's Day sales we encountered appear to mirror the experience of the apparel industry as a whole. In addition, planned product conversions for two major customers and associated inventory write-downs have impacted profitability for the quarter.
"However, we are encouraged by retail response to our new product offerings, including Black Label and Cotton Flex," Haggar said.
Haggar expects complete third quarter results to be announced on or about July 23.
